Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

In cases where, on the death of pensioner and spouse, family pension has to pass over to another family member, procedure above should be followed if the family member has been co-authorized in the PPO. Otherwise, he may be advised to approach the office in which the pensioner  
last served for issue of a fresh PPO.
